name: R Draconis
method: 5x5 px box aperture on background-subtracted level-2 image; background and noise from 5-10 px annulus; no aperture correction, neighbours not deblended

flag_values.saturated: SPHEREx flags overflow inside the aperture but every pixel has a value; flux accuracy not verified
flag_values.saturated_core: source too bright: core pixels have no value, flux is not usable
flag_values.bad_pixel: detector artefact or missing pixel inside aperture
